gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with histologically confirmed newly diagnosed glioblastoma per CNS WHO 2021 classification

candidate_evidence.quote: Vortioxetine will be added to standard of care temozolomide chemoradiotherapy for patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma
The ReVoGlio trial aims at demonstrating that vortioxetine, a drug selected based on ex vivo drug profiling (pharmacoscopy), is of benefit for patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma.

tumour_pk_planned_evidence.quote: Drug exposure: Plasmatic concentration of vortioxetine

role_evidence.quote: Vortioxetine will be added to standard of care temozolomide chemoradiotherapy for patients with newly diagnosed glioblastoma

arms: Vortioxetine in addition to the standard of care

role_evidence.quote: Concomitant chemotherapy with temozolomide (75 mg/m2 daily throughout radiotherapy, including at weekends) followed by six cycles of maintenance temozolomide (150-200 mg/m2, 5 out of 28 days).

agents.drug_class_hint: alkylating agent, GBM standard of care
arms: Vortioxetine in addition to the standard of care

source_quote.quote: O6-methylguanine DNA methyltransferase (MGMT) promotor methylation status known or tissue available for testing

coder_notes: Repurposing rationale stated (pharmacoscopy ex vivo screen identified vortioxetine) but no specific molecular antitumour mechanism stated, so stated_antitumour_mechanism null. MGMT: entry requires status known or tissue available, not a specific methylation status; coded eligibility because it is an entry requirement, but it does not select by status (could be argued exploratory_correlative). Single arm; OS compared to external control data. PK is plasma only.
